modes.AUTO: model classifies, engine computes, lawyer confirms
modes.DAYS_IN_TEXT: the number of days comes from the order; the model extracts it; not explicit -> review
modes.CONDITIONAL: a deadline exists only in a given hypothesis (depends on the text) -> review
modes.REVIEW: body regulation, divergent case law or a different anchor -> human
modes.HEARING_DATE: date set by the court (docket), not counted from the publication
modes.HEARING_ANCHORED: anchored to the hearing, not to the publication
modes.NO_FATAL_DEADLINE: act admissible at any time: no legal due date
